description: This file defines a Java interface CommandHandler with generic request and response types, including a handle method and a default matches method, used for command processing within the Fineract project.

classes.name: CommandHandler
classes.description: A generic interface for handling commands with a handle method and a default matching method.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the provided command and returns a response.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if the handler matches the command based on payload type.
